chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Wassha, from Aban, from Suleiman ibn Khalid, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the fulfillment of the Witr prayer after the Dhuhr prayer, so he said: 'Fulfill it as Witr always, just as it was missed by you.' I said: 'And two Witr prayers in one night?' He said: 'Yes. Is it not so that one of the two is a fulfillment (of the missed one)?'

key_terms.قَضَاءٌ: Fulfillment/makeup of a missed obligation or recommended act

ai.seo_question: How should the missed Witr prayer be performed if done after Dhuhr?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the makeup (Qada) of the missed Witr prayer is performed as a single unit, distinct from the night's primary Witr, thereby resolving the juristic question of whether one incurs two Witr prayers in a single night. This ruling underscores the Shia principle that Qada prayers maintain their original form and count independently, ensuring the completeness of worship without redundancy. The hadith highlights the precision in distinguishing between voluntary acts performed at their prescribed time and those fulfilled later to compensate for omission.
